items.information: Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ## First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules. ## Implementation of 4-Pad The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026). ## Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information: This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission. Imagination Station opens at 10am - you will not be able to get in earlier. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8843e254b05ca879fa0ab066c46e77b7920e76c8/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)

items.information: Välkomna till Kublördag Jönköping! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Kublördag Jönköping! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: Newtown New Event 2027 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. items.information: ### Espetadores só são permitidos como acompanhantes de competidores. items.name: Uppsala FTOpen 2027
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Uppsala FTOpen 2027, den första tävlingen i Sverige där grenen FTO hålls officiellt! **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. -- A warm welcome to Uppsala FTOpen 2027, the first competition in Sweden where the event FTO is held officially! **N.B.:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
